six_zone_reuse_census.conclusion: types $24, $2E, $56 (and children $57/$58) appear in no other zone: researching them buys MGHZ coverage only; $21 research (shared with THZ) and $2F footwear research (SEZ) already pay off beyond MGHZ

art.spring_shoes: placement aux $AC/$AC; VRAM load $26840 -> tile $AC (16 tiles); behaviour/graphics shared with SEZ (docs/powerup-shoes-audit.md)
art.rocket_shoes: type $10 parameter $04 monitor; monitor art and dynamic selector unchanged

orientation.mirror_rule: original coordinate mirror table + alternate art base (bit4 states 3/6 vs 4/5), never a whole-bitmap flip

0x21.reuse: same ROM state table/callbacks as THZ type $21 (type table entry $065FA, state table $0C:$B1C4); MGHZ differences: art bases $7C/$8E, all 15 records carry flags $10 (alternate states 5/6), parameter span up to $16*16 = 352 px

orientation.mirror_rule: bit4 never set by scripts or placement flags: unmirrored only; bit4=1 images in the PNG package are diagnostics, NOT approved

behaviour_notes: state 1 callback $B49A: sleeps while +$04 bit6 set; when player |dx| < $30 and |player vx| < $100 requests state 2
state 2 script sets X velocity and animates, callback $B4D1 selects vx = +$0080 for parameter 0 else -$0080, clears Y velocity, requests state 3
state 3 callback $B4F0 integrates motion, calls contact helper $0434/$0431, deletes itself when $037A reports off-screen/blocked
records come in pairs 16 px apart with parameters 1 then 0 (opposite directions); all at Y 48/112
0x24.behaviour_evidence: BYTE-VERIFIED ASSEMBLY $0C:$B490..$B50D read; no oracle audit

orientation.mirror_rule: bit4 never set by scripts or placement flags: unmirrored only; bit4=1 images in the PNG package are diagnostics, NOT approved

behaviour_notes: placed once per act; extents (0,0) -> no contact box
state 2 script spawns three type $2E children with parameters 1/2/3 and offsets (4,0), (0,-2), (-4,-4) then requests state 1
state 3 animates frames 1..3 (callback $8B10) and ends with callback $034A (generic delete)
art: VRAM base $72 (10 tiles from ROM $26780); aux1 $13/$1B differs by act and is not a mirror base (bit4 never set)
0x2E.behaviour_evidence: DECODED DATA (scripts) + controlled initialiser result; callbacks unaudited
0x2E.community_label_lead: ROM $26780 is listed as "oil splash (MGHZ)" (community table; lead only, identity unresolved)

initialisation.effects: D3B3 = $16 (dynamic art selector); $D494 bit5 set + $D495 = 15 (sprite palette index 15); CALL $81A6 (HUD allocator, type $12); +$26 = 10 (health); requests state 11
initialisation.shared_state0_callback: 0x974C (shared boss init: $D44E = zone+1, $D4A5 = 0, CALL $81A6/$8199, request state 1)

support_dependencies.0x12: HUD slide-away (shared; allocated by $81A6 from state 0 and state 3)

art.community_label_lead: ROM $17680 listed as "MGHZ pole climber boss" art (community table; lead only)

boss.mirror_policy: bank $1E code never sets +$04 bit 4 and the record flags are 0: runtime art is unmirrored; forced bit4=1 is diagnostic only

arena_and_camera.index_rule: index = zone ($D297) + $D4A5 (starts 0); state 1 trigger table $1E:$97A1 (strict dx/dy distance), state 2 camera-target offset table $1E:$9808
arena_and_camera.thz_row_cross_check: index 0 gives (160,256) and (-256,-160): reproduces accepted THZ3 trigger and camera target (1680,78)

arena_derivation.note: THZ3 audit: X limit is exclusive so the pan ends 1 px short; the same shared routine is used. Not executed for MGHZ in this census.

completion.shared_defeat_script: state 4 uses script $95CC identical to the THZ boss table (spawns $34 puffs, calls $9A1E/$9A29)
completion.expected: converges on shared $0A/$0F objects and player state $20 as in THZ3, but THZ3-specific constants are unverified for MGHZ3
completion.no_sign: MGHZ3 has no type $18 sign; act clear depends on the boss chain
completion.status: UNRESOLVED: dedicated boss task must confirm; do not copy THZ/GPZ completion

dependencies_summary: dynamic art selector $16 (64 tiles + 12 shared explosion tiles)
shared boss framework tables indexed by zone
camera lock/pan + player arena clamp via shared EDGE rules

support_art_dependencies.platform_28: placement aux0 $6A; VRAM load $26470 -> tile $6A (8 tiles); mapping $9217 frame 1 (docs/isometric-platform-audit.md section 3)
support_art_dependencies.breakable_fragments_type_07: type $07 mapping $8C71 (24 frames); fragment art source not extracted here
support_art_dependencies.sign_18: dynamic selector $12 overwrites VRAM tiles $6A..$A9 at act clear (original behaviour; keep sprite atlases separate)

Type $24 and $2E gameplay (hazard/contact/damage) is not audited.
